描述_ZN: The Longevity Star Scroll, Ming, painted by Zhu Zhanji, on silk with color, 29.3 cm in length and 35.6 cm in width.　　Signed: "A picture of the longevity star written by the imperial brush, given to Xia Yuanji, the Crown Prince's Young Master and Minister of Household Affairs." Inscribed with two seals: "Guang Yun Zhi Bao" and "Imperial House Book". There is an inscription of the recipient, Xia Yuanji, in front of the center of the painting, but the handwriting is blurred.　　In the picture, the longevity star is standing by a stream at the foot of a mountain, with a short head, a high forehead, white beard and hair, wearing a wide robe and holding his hands in front of his chest as if he is meditating, with an immortal style. The vividness and distinctive features of the longevity star, the rigidity and softness of the brushwork, and the roughness and strength of the depiction of the rocks, show the painting attainments of Emperor Xuanzong of the Ming Dynasty.　　Purchased in 1997 in Xiangyin, Hunan.
